payload.title: Real-replay and fault-test adaptive dependency-aware live fusion mesh v2
payload.work_clay: Replay current repository work events, branch feedback and dependency projections through broadcast, tag-only and CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V2_CANDIDATE v0.2 routing. Measure relevant-branch recall, full-payload and digest bytes, invalidation latency, stale window, false interrupts, repair success and CPU/RAM/I/O. Inject missing dependency edges, stale projection epochs, duplicate deltas, out-of-order causal predecessors and crash/restart. Validate adaptive RoutePlan TARGETED_DELTA vs DENSE_FANOUT vs DIGEST_ONLY. Do not promote the candidate from synthetic evidence alone.
payload.reason_clay: A deterministic 5,000-delta synthetic test supports dependency-aware routing over tag-only and reduces full-payload fanout versus broadcast, but an 8% incomplete dependency projection still misses material deliveries. Fresh 2026 IVM evidence also shows cost-aware strategy selection is preferable to dogmatic incrementalization. Real shared-state replay and anti-entropy recovery are therefore the next discriminating evidence before any owner-fixed mesh change.
payload.completion_clay: Real-repo replay report contains exact repo/commit/epoch hashes, raw rows and metadata; broadcast/tag-only/v0.2 adaptive results are matched; stale/missing/duplicate/out-of-order/restart faults are executed; anti-entropy permanent-miss rate and repair latency are measured; false interrupts and route-cost prediction error are measured; all effects remain proposal/research-only; candidate receives SUPPORTED, REFUTED, REVISE or NO_CHANGE verdict; affected branches receive explicit feedback; no current ClayCode BASE acceptance credit is granted from this work.
payload.executor_policy: Use the first non-overlapping worker with repository checkout plus local Python/SQLite/ClayGraph capability. Refresh canonical/head and active work before effect. Do not displace WORK-CLAYCODE-BASE14-CLOSE-20260809 when the same executor is needed for the BASE critical path; run concurrently only with spare capacity or when it directly unblocks work-state projection reliability. No paid training. No Frank self-harness authority.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed mesh protocol explicitly supersedes the candidate
A newer real execution receipt already performs the same matched replay and fault matrix
Current repo state makes the synthetic dependency model materially inapplicable
